new: The Windows-first Tailscale adapter invokes the installed local `tailscale` CLI on a worker thread. It may read machine-readable `status` and `serve status` so it can distinguish installation, connection, origin, Serve ownership, and public-exposure conflicts. `serve status --json` includes the local Serve configuration and Funnel-allowance flags used for the same endpoints, so the adapter MUST NOT invoke the `tailscale funnel` subcommand at all.
